tbesh_html:
1) out there, onwards, further
1a) yonder, beyond (of place)
1b) onwards (of time)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to the distance, i.e. far away; also (of time) thus far
strongs_1890.derivation: from the primitive form of the article (hal);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: back, beyond, (hence,-) forward, hitherto, thence, forth, yonder.
